name: Shenzhen Batian Ecotypic Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Batian Ecotypic Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and operation of compound fertilizers and others in the People's Republic of China. It offers new fertilizers, slow-release fertilizers, stable compound fertilizers, microbial agents, microbial compound fertilizers, organic fertilizers, organic-inorganic compound fertilizers, soil conditioners, liquid fertilizers, water-soluble fertilizers, medium and trace element fertilizers, and other types of fertilizers.
